svg.text: FINAL LOOK - in use: miter saw raised, drop-leaves up, laser well open
The scissor lift brings the DWS779 deck flush with the top; the hood rises with it. Drop-leaves add 24" of support each side. The laser sits over the open well for rotary work.
Hatch leaves are in the slot beside the lift bay. The 4" flex hose and the saw's cord follow the platform up and down.
